title: Increasing Triplet Subsequence
description: Given an integer array `nums`, determine whether there are indices `i < j < k` such that `nums[i] < nums[j] < nums[k]`. The selected indices need not be adjacent. Input: `nums`. Output: true if such a triplet exists, otherwise false.
hints: Scan once to identify the boundary or state where the answer changes.
Test already ordered, reversed, duplicate, and minimum-size inputs.
